---
title: "Assignments"
---

Each participant produces **two individual products** (there are no groups): a **research proposal** on their own question, and a **Results section** for one of the five FLUID-ICU questions, Q1 to Q5. Everything is submitted by email to the course lead, Vương Mỹ Lượng ([myluong1710@gmail.com](mailto:myluong1710@gmail.com)). The marks are formative: they help you improve.

## Product 1: the research proposal (sent before Session 1) {#before-session-1}

The proposal brief is the one document to read before Session 1. It arrives by email with the proposal template, the presentation guide and the proposal rubric. Each part is modelled live in Sessions 1 to 7 and written as homework. Everyone submits the proposal and 6 slides before 19:30 on the day of Session 8, and about 5 volunteers present.

## Product 2: the Results section (shared at the end of Session 6) {#session-6}

The manuscript brief and the files below are sent by email at the end of Session 6, when you choose your question. We give you the results pack, and you write a submission-ready Results section with a working title, Table 1 and one main table or figure. Methods, Introduction, Discussion and Abstract are optional, and the trainers give feedback on them too.

## Timeline

- **Proposal:** Part 1 after Sessions 1–2, Part 2 after Sessions 3–4, Part 3 after Sessions 5–6, Part 4 after Session 7. Everyone emails the proposal and 6 slides before 19:30 on the day of Session 8 (about 5 volunteers present).
- **Results section:** the five questions in Session 5, your question (Q1 to Q5) chosen at the end of Session 6, the Results written live on Q1 in Session 7, where your reviewer is announced. Email your Results section to your reviewer and the course lead by **23:59 on the day of Session 8 (19 December 2026)**. Review report due **2 January 2027**. Revised Results section and response to the reviewer due **30 January 2027**.

All the Word templates are on the [Templates](templates.qmd) page.
